description: This is a Python source file defining a Serializer class for caching HTTP responses using msgpack serialization. The class provides methods to serialize, deserialize, and prepare HTTP responses, mainly for caching purposes within a Python HTTP client library.

classes.name: Serializer
classes.description: A class for serializing and deserializing HTTP response data for cache storage, supporting multiple versions.
